definitionZh: 通过不同比例的计数器、中风、间距和克宁以及该类型其他方面,将样式从窄到宽。 这一般会以微妙的方式改变打字的颜色,因此可能与重量轴和等级轴结合使用.
sourceDefinition: Adjust the style from narrower to wider, by varying the proportions of counters, strokes, spacing and kerning, and other aspects of the type. This typically changes the typographic color in a subtle way, and so may be used in conjunction with Weight and Grade axes.
